reviews.review: The First Descendant" is a great game! The graphics are stunning, and the combat mechanics are engaging from the very first minutes. The multiplayer mode adds a lot of fun, especially when playing with friends. The story is interesting and captivating. Overall, the game delivers a lot of positive emotions and is definitely worth your time! I recommend it!

Game randomly closes at the worst possible times, like middle or end of a dungeon, or after a really tough boss. It could happen after 10 mins of playing, or 5 hours of playing, and there's seemingly no rhyme or reason as to what's causing it. No error message either. Game is really fun tho, but if you have this problem like many others since the game came out, prepare to get butthurt.
The game is lowkey bad, theres no fun element in it, just a repetitive cycle, where you shoot, and get.

Edit 1: Hold off for now, they're making changes to make the game better but here are some issues that still need to be resolved:

- Endgame loop is to grind for Heroes to grind for more Heroes faster. !!!BUT!!! There's a cap of 10. There are 23 Descendants, so the game just ends (unless you buy slots). Wait until this gets removed

- Player collision is god awful, ruins the entire game for no benefit
- Can't earn any skins. Can't earn anything really. There's no sense of accomplish here.
- Long craft times, and 5 craft limits. Again, there's no benefit for this existing.
- Orbs around bosses "immune" phase. Scrap this.
- The Sharen outpost farms get stale so fast; to many materials are centered around this. Plus other players actively grief it sometimes.(you can do it private, but that sucks)
- Dungeon AFKers
- Lvl1 are able to go into hard mode bosses. This needs a level cap on it.
- Invasion missions offer limited Haley materials based on a timer. This timer is strangling this game because if you wipe ONCE, everyone just quits the party and queues again. Huge time waster.

- Honestly, this game is just an advertisement to just play Warframe instead. Everything is the same but Warframe is decades ahead in content to do.

====THERE IS A SOLID GAME HERE BUT ITS BEING STRANGLED BY THE CURRENT SYSTEMS IN PLACE====

100hrs in, It's standard shooter, but it just feels fun.
It's not p2w. You can't buy power/skill/weapons, only time skip.

The best character in the game? Bunny. How much? Free, early in the story.
The best gun in the game? Thunder-cage. How much? Free, also a story weapon.
Ultimate versions are slightly more HP/DEF, and offer a better ability modification.

Cons:
- Body collision with players; dont put realism in video games, its a video game.
- Jump Puzzle collect orbs; 3D platformers are always awful, this quest appears ~9 times in the story.
- Missions are the same on each map segments
- Story forgot to explain modules (Upgrade increase HP/DEF modules, the game gets harder without these)
- Disappointing story ending
- Some characters AOE are so blinding, I can't even see the thing I'm shotting at anymore (set effects to low)
- There's an annoying beeping sound during loading screens, WHY!?
- Some skins are $40

Pros:
- Regular looter shooter, basically destiny/borderlands
- Grappling, double jump, speed increase, and roll. Lots of movement, Titanfall-esq
- Good dungeons, people can't get lost
- Good Graphics
- It's not Destiny. Destiny is not free, it's a trial, this is free (for now)

Conclusion:
Quit the game if you don't like it in the first 4-5hrs, that is the game. You just shot things and collect loot. Endgame you kill even more things and collect more loot.

If you liked borderlands tiny tina wonderlands chaos chambers farming, then you'll like this game.
This game is like a good slice of pepperoni pizza: it's visually good. And the gameplay? It's like the perfect crust: solid, satisfying, and a little bit cheesy. 🍕

So Lets start the grind has gone from ridiculous to absolutely insane. Why get guns or do any of the weapons when my Fryena, bunny or ines is so OP that using guns is pointless. But to me what really threw this game over the edge for me was I had grind out ult bunny and min/maxed her out only to find that the game is so littered with min/maxxed bunnies because of the free ult bunny they were giving away that most missions I just sat around watching this ult bunny or ines just delete everything. Why do anything in the game when the grind is so horrible and the pointlessness of new weaponry just makes it seem like why bother. It hurts becuase i love the way the characters look and the outfits but sadly that doesnt save bad game play and balance.

Now I get that this game might not be something that many others enjoy. Story is weak to forgettable, most if not all character lore and backgrounds are bland and vanilla, and super expensive long and grindy. But I find the combat to be fun, and oddly the game itself is fun and I do have lots of fun playing this game. It looks great, plays well usually. I love this game and find enjoyment from it, I tried warframe and found myself bored and did not continue but at least this game kept me going.
